automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.date_policy: A source needs a visible publication or update date that unambiguously falls inside this interval. A date-only value on the lower-boundary calendar date is excluded because its publication time is unknown.

federation.collector_rule: Retain only an AI-assisted-development practice implication when a source concerns an upstream-owned entity.

source.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
source.date_basis: The first-party source visibly states October 29, 2026, which is unambiguously inside the interval from 2026-10-28T00:29:36Z through 2026-10-30T00:29:36Z.

qualifying_updates.short_factual_summary: OpenAI published an updated Model Spec organized around faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The update adds guidance on context, oversight, agency, instruction-conflict resolution, and communicating side effects; it also says the Spec describes intended behavior that models do not yet fully reflect.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Treat durable agent instructions as an explicit, reviewable authority hierarchy rather than prose that an agent can interpret freely. Supply contextual evidence deliberately, expose assumptions that affect intent, preserve human authorization for consequential actions, state uncertainty and side effects in agent outputs, and verify behavior with controls rather than assuming a specification guarantees runtime compliance.
follow_up_notes: If ingested, retain only the downstream instruction-authority, context-evidence, oversight, side-effect, and verification guidance.
Do not create a local OpenAI, GPT, or Model Spec encyclopedia page; those entity facts belong in the upstream AI wiki.
